MESSAGE.value:
feat: Add Azure AD authentication support to Azure OpenAI service
- Add support for DefaultAzureCredential with proper token scope handling - Enhance Azure service to support both legacy API key and Azure AD authentication - Improve Azure service environment verification with better error handling - Update Azure embedder classes to use centralized authentication logic - Add comprehensive test suite with 27 test cases covering all authentication scenarios - Add detailed error messages and troubleshooting guidance for Azure AD authentication - Fix Azure AD token provider to use correct scope for Azure OpenAI services - Maintain backward compatibility with existing API key authentication
Authentication priority: 1. API Key (highest priority - backward compatibility) 2. Azure AD (fallback when no API key)
Azure AD authentication methods supported: - Azure CLI (az login) - Service Principal (environment variables) - Managed Identity (Azure resources) - Environment Credential - Workload Identity (Kubernetes)
Closes: Azure AD authentication enhancement Signed-off-by: bharatnpti <bharatnpti@gmail.com>

fix: Address maintainer feedback for Azure service implementation
- Add missing type annotations for token_provider and test_auth functions - Restructure tests from class-based to flat tests with natural language names - Follow project conventions for test naming (test_that_* pattern) - Maintain all 27 test cases with improved readability - Ensure compliance with ruff and mypy standards
Addresses maintainer feedback about: - Missing type annotations in azure_service.py and test file - Test suite classes should be flat tests with natural language names - Alignment with existing project coding style and conventions
Signed-off-by: bharatnpti <bharatnpti@gmail.com>
